content.text: PTÁČEK: Oh yes, that is him. But me naming a mine after him? Nonsense! Unless he bought it from me. But would those little poems really earn him that much? It is possible. If he has enough money, I will gladly sell it to him. Write, bard, and save up, and when you have twenty million, the day will come when we settle accounts.
content.source: The Messenger from Liptákov, Jára Cimrman
